name: permaqr
description: Self-hosted dynamic QR codes that live on your domain. Runs on Cloudflare's free tier.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrations:apply:local && wrangler dev
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the single PermaQR dashboard admin. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 24`.

DB.description: D1 database named `permaqr`. Stores codes, scan analytics, and the fallback message.

CODES.description: KV namespace used as the hot cache for redirect lookups. D1 remains the source of truth.
